system.name: POLAR (program-of-layers)
system.one_liner: Training-free program-of-layers: pretrained LLM layers are skipped or looped per input, with a lightweight network predicting the program.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the same layer chain once per input and change only the route: dashed outline for a skipped layer, a green region plus a loop-back arrow for repeated layers, a snowflake on every frozen layer, and a small pseudocode box under the rows that restates each route with colour-coded comments.
lessons.suits: Dynamic-depth, layer-routing, early-exit or looped-transformer papers that must show per-input execution paths over a fixed set of layers.

evidence: the dynamic inference of POLAR executes an inputspecific program π = (i1, . . . , iK) that calls the functions with layer skipping and recurrence.
Skip: omit one or more layers
Recurrent: reuse one or more layers for iterative refinement

summary: POLAR (program-of-layers) shows that the frozen layers of a pretrained LLM can be skipped or looped to form an input-specific program, and trains a lightweight network to predict such programs. Figure 1 is a single-column diagram of the same layer chain drawn twice, once per input. In the top row, input x0 passes Layers 0 and 1 twice inside a pale-green looped region and skips a dashed Layer d+1; in the bottom row, input x1 skips Layer 0 and loops Layers d to d+2. Every layer carries a snowflake for frozen weights, outputs are peach boxes, and a curly bracket names the set of frozen pretrained layer functions. Two dashed boxes below give matching pseudocode with blue comments recurrence, skip and keep.
summary_zh: POLAR 让冻结的预训练层按输入被跳过或循环，形成每个输入专属的“层程序”。图 1 把同一条层链画两遍，上行循环层 0–1 并跳过层 d+1，下行跳过层 0 并循环层 d 到 d+2，下方伪代码逐行标注。
notes: The two pseudocode boxes are raster images, so their text is not in the digest; it was read from the preview. The prior kind model-anatomy is kept as primary and side-by-side-contrast added because the two rows differ only in the route. The bottom-right pseudocode box has a solid left edge and a dashed outline, the left box is fully dashed.
